scope: Existing IndustrialContext/Event/Evaluation shape unchanged since v3; additive agent port and question scope.
rules: Integer cents, integer quantities, explicit EUR and native provenance. Actor provenance never grants rights.
Current IndustrialContext excludes future/operator events. Only authenticated release supplies ReleasedIndustrialEvent.
Alternative canonicalResourceId names C1 emergency quote capacity. URG-IND-ALT-8 is not additional supply beyond URG-1.
All-commitment calculation remains server-side; bounded model projection only.
Approval and simulated execution are distinct durable records. No real ERP supplier action.
Alternative destination and current-stock lot independence are explicit. Unknown upstream manufacturing is retained, not promoted to whole-supplier independence.
Delivery quote aliases its C1 transportQuoteId; cost freight+handling is charged once, no consolidation without a received grouping quote.
A confirmation has confirmationId and eventId separately. Only explicitly confirmed purchase lines change ETA. Competitor inability is a separate released confirmation.
Purchase and transfer steps create future demo orders and dated planned allocations, never an immediate destination-stock receipt. CRM offer remains draft and revenue/contribution potential.
Analysis trigger deduplication includes released event revision and qualification; budget persists across every version of the same event. Blocked differs from uncertain.
IndustrialEvaluationInput.executionState is mandatory, including explicitly empty state. Load ledger and snapshot under the same company lock and require the same businessRevision.
Active source stock holds reduce usable stock, never physical_quantity. Scheduled transfers add one dated destination resource tied to those holds. Never introduce a purchase twice in C1 and ledger.
Committed capacity use aggregates by canonical resource across business revisions. resourceVersion is audit and cannot reset capacity without explicit newly received supply identity.
Existing draft offers and their reserved allocations reduce remaining qualified demand, without creating an accepted sale or silently releasing holds.
Every ledger mutation advances the same business R and invalidates dependent pending work; historical approved/executed receipts remain.
